name: OpenAI Provider
description: This enables the use of OpenAI for the AI module.
consumes_plugin_types: ai:OperationType (implements chat, embeddings, moderation, text_to_image, text_to_speech, speech_to_text operation-type interfaces from AI Core)
project_description:
Want access to the best and latest AI models? OpenAI is your go-to AI provider. Integrated with the AI module , it allows you to leverage cutting-edge models like GPT-4, DALL-E, and Whisper. Whether it's text generation, image creation, or speech-to-text, OpenAI provides some of the most advanced AI capabilities available today.

 Features 
 Use OpenAI with all the AI module family, allowing seamless text generation, image creation, and more directly within Drupal.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Set up an API key using the Key module with your OpenAI credentials. 
 Visit /admin/config/ai/providers/openai and link the key you created. 
 You're all set to harness the full power of OpenAI's models. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 The AI module .

 AI Search integration 
 Companion module VDB Provider for AI Search integration 

 Supporting this Module 
 Support the AI module on OpenCollective .

 Community Documentation 
 The documentation is available on https://project.pages.drupalcode.org/ai/
